about_the_game:
It's the next chapter of your fantasy adventure! This tileset collection includes everything you need to build stunning castle exteriors and detailed interiors, complete with a throne room fit for kings. After your heroes get thrown into the dungeon, they'll need to venture below and escape through the murky sewers and explore the eerie catacombs-- where they can discover the location of the necromancer's rituals or find treasure in the ancient crypts!

All of it is designed to work seamlessly with previous TIME ELEMENTS tilesets, and it matches the ELEMENTS character sprites, so you can bring your game world to life! The world of TIME ELEMENTS expands to Castles and Catacombs—rule and explore!

Contents:

* Four mix-and-match biomes: Castle exterior, Castle interior, Catacombs and Sewers
* Terrain and water autotiles with sewer waterfalls.
* Altars, tombs, and crypts-- with skeletons or treasure inside!
* Animated torches and candles.
* Animated doors, gates, and sewer grates.
* Bonus! A second version with alternate colors that match my Time Fantasy series.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
